derivation.note: Each export is its source with the gain that brings it to the target loudness, measured by ffmpeg's ebur128 filter, then a limiter, as mono MP3 without metadata. Where the limiter takes more than 0.5 LU, the gain is raised by the difference and the conversion made again, up to 3 conversions in all.

host_again_1.direction: [excited] Another game? [squeals] Yay, more cheering for me!
host_again_1.text: Another game? Yay, more cheering for me!

host_again_2.direction: [cheerful] New game, new luck! [excited] Who's ready?
host_again_2.text: New game, new luck! Who's ready?

host_again_3.direction: [giggles] Back for more? [excited] The dice are all warmed up!
host_again_3.text: Back for more? The dice are all warmed up!

host_black_wins_1.direction: [excited] Black takes the game! [cheerful] Well played, both!
host_black_wins_1.text: Black takes the game! Well played, both!

host_black_wins_2.direction: [squeals] It's Black's game! [excited] What a match, you two!
host_black_wins_2.text: It's Black's game! What a match, you two!

host_black_wins_3.direction: [cheerful] Three cheers for Black, and for White too!
host_black_wins_3.text: Three cheers for Black, and for White too!

host_capture_1.direction: [cheerful] Pop! One piece hops off the board!
host_capture_1.text: Pop! One piece hops off the board!

host_capture_3.direction: [cheerful] A capture! [giggles] A little more room on the board!
host_capture_3.text: A capture! A little more room on the board!

host_capture_4.direction: [laughs] And that piece is off for a little rest!
host_capture_4.text: And that piece is off for a little rest!

host_capture_heavy_1.direction: [gasps] Wowee! The whole board felt that one!
host_capture_heavy_1.text: Wowee! The whole board felt that one!

host_capture_heavy_2.direction: [excited] Kaboom! A mighty piece leaves the board!
host_capture_heavy_2.text: Kaboom! A mighty piece leaves the board!

host_capture_heavy_4.direction: [excited] Big, big moment! [giggles] Somebody pinch me!
host_capture_heavy_4.text: Big, big moment! Somebody pinch me!

host_capture_heavy_5.direction: [gasps] Oh my! [excited] Hold on to your seats, you two!
host_capture_heavy_5.text: Oh my! Hold on to your seats, you two!

host_capture_queen_1.direction: [gasps] A queen is taken! [excited] Deep breaths, you two!
host_capture_queen_1.text: A queen is taken! Deep breaths, you two!

host_capture_queen_2.direction: [excited] Oh, the queen! My heart just did a flip!
host_capture_queen_2.text: Oh, the queen! My heart just did a flip!

host_capture_queen_4.direction: [squeals] Queen down! [laughs] My microphone is shaking!
host_capture_queen_4.text: Queen down! My microphone is shaking!

host_draw_1.direction: [gasps] A draw! [laughs] Nobody wins, and everybody wins!
host_draw_1.text: A draw! Nobody wins, and everybody wins!

host_draw_2.direction: [cheerful] It's a draw! [excited] You two are perfectly matched!
host_draw_2.text: It's a draw! You two are perfectly matched!

host_draw_3.direction: [giggles] All even! [cheerful] Shake hands, both of you!
host_draw_3.text: All even! Shake hands, both of you!

host_empty_roll_1.direction: [gasps] The dice said no! [giggles] Pass it along!
host_empty_roll_1.text: The dice said no! Pass it along!

host_empty_roll_2.direction: [sighs] Aww, bad luck! [cheerful] Those dice are so cheeky!
host_empty_roll_2.text: Aww, bad luck! Those dice are so cheeky!

host_empty_roll_3.direction: [giggles] Oh no, the dice took a nap! [cheerful] Next turn!
host_empty_roll_3.text: Oh no, the dice took a nap! Next turn!

host_empty_roll_4.direction: [gasps] Uh-oh! [laughs] The dice are playing tricks on us!
host_empty_roll_4.text: Uh-oh! The dice are playing tricks on us!

host_en_passant_1.direction: [gasps] En passant! [excited] A rare sideways capture!
host_en_passant_1.text: En passant! A rare sideways capture!

host_en_passant_2.direction: [curious] Did you see that? [cheerful] A pawn caught in passing!
host_en_passant_2.text: Did you see that? A pawn caught in passing!

host_handoff_1.direction: [cheerful] Now pass the remote over! [excited] Black's turn!
host_handoff_1.text: Now pass the remote over! Black's turn!

host_handoff_2.direction: [excited] After every turn, the remote changes hands!
host_handoff_2.text: After every turn, the remote changes hands!

host_handoff_3.direction: [giggles] Remote swap time! [excited] Black, roll away!
host_handoff_3.text: Remote swap time! Black, roll away!

host_intro_1.direction: [excited] You two play, and I'll do the cheering!
host_intro_1.text: You two play, and I'll do the cheering!

host_intro_2.direction: [giggles] No dice for me! [cheerful] I'm just the host!
host_intro_2.text: No dice for me! I'm just the host!

host_intro_3.direction: [excited] Welcome, both of you! [cheerful] White rolls first!
host_intro_3.text: Welcome, both of you! White rolls first!

host_intro_4.direction: [excited] One board, two players, three dice! [giggles] Go!
host_intro_4.text: One board, two players, three dice! Go!

host_intro_5.direction: [whispers] Ooh, a brand new game... [excited] I can't wait!
host_intro_5.text: Ooh, a brand new game... I can't wait!

host_promotion_1.direction: [gasps] Look! [excited] That little pawn grew up!
host_promotion_1.text: Look! That little pawn grew up!

host_promotion_2.direction: [squeals] A pawn crossed the whole board! [cheerful] Amazing!
host_promotion_2.text: A pawn crossed the whole board! Amazing!

host_promotion_3.direction: [excited] Ta-da! The pawn got a big upgrade!
host_promotion_3.text: Ta-da! The pawn got a big upgrade!

host_white_wins_1.direction: [excited] White wins! [cheerful] What a game, both of you!
host_white_wins_1.text: White wins! What a game, both of you!

host_white_wins_2.direction: [squeals] Victory for White! [cheerful] You both played great!
host_white_wins_2.text: Victory for White! You both played great!

host_white_wins_3.direction: [cheerful] Hooray, White! [giggles] And hooray, Black, too!
host_white_wins_3.text: Hooray, White! And hooray, Black, too!

host_win_1.direction: [excited] And that's the game! [cheerful] Bravo, you two!
host_win_1.text: And that's the game! Bravo, you two!

host_win_2.direction: [squeals] We have a winner! [cheerful] Great game, everyone!
host_win_2.text: We have a winner! Great game, everyone!
